title: 卓上書類ラミネーター
description: 図書館・学校事務室・公共施設の作業台向けの卓上ラミネーター外観。アーチ状上カバーと下トレー、左右端部、別々に開いた前方投入・後方排出の喉部、間隔のある上下固定ローラーと案内条、無表示操作部、解除レバー外装、後部接続口・下面ねじ・ゴム脚を造形。フィルムや書類は付属せず、搬送・加熱・温度制御・解除機能はありません。安全性・ラミネート性能や認証は示しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.423 × 0.127 × 0.241 m、6,024三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A desktop laminator exterior for library, school-office and civic-facility worktops. Includes an arched upper hood/lower tray, side caps, separately open front inlet and rear outlet throats, spaced fixed upper/lower rollers and guide strips, unmarked controls, release-lever exterior, rear connection, underside screws and rubber feet. No film or documents are included; transport, heating, temperature control and release functions are absent. No safety, lamination-performance or certification claims. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.423 × 0.127 × 0.241 m; 6,024 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
